coverage.notes: The Fudan International Students Office 2026 complete list and five official descriptions/brochures identify five English-taught direct-entry programmes. The source catalogue is 2026 rather than 2027; the programme identities are historical leads, not an independently complete 2027 list. Full IB Diploma rules, DP Course Results policy, 2027 dates, fee levels, seat limits and cutoffs remain unresolved. Distinguish the separate CSCA subject exams from IB subject equivalence. Chinese-taught degrees, graduate degrees and short courses are excluded. No separate comprehensive first-year faculty catalogue was needed for this bounded English-taught scope.

institution.summary: Shanghai research university founded in 1905 with campuses at Handan, Fenglin, Jiangwan and Zhangjiang.

programmes.name: International Organizations and Global Governance (IOGG)
programmes.about: An English-taught law-degree pathway examining international organizations, diplomacy, international relations and global public policy.
programmes.overview: This four-year Bachelor of Laws programme examines how international institutions, rules and governance systems address cross-border problems. Students study international law, political economy, public policy and negotiation alongside China-focused public administration and diplomacy. Quantitative and qualitative research methods support analysis of real-world policy questions, while the study plan includes a professional internship and a graduation thesis. The published curriculum frames progression toward international organizations, public bodies, nongovernmental organizations, international business or further academic study.

programmes.name: Undergraduate International Program in Economics (UIPE)
programmes.about: A four-year economics degree combining English-taught economics, quantitative training and liberal-arts breadth with opportunities for research and practice.
programmes.overview: Students build a foundation in mathematics, statistics, microeconomics and macroeconomics before progressing to econometrics, international economics, finance and economic issues in China. The programme combines an English-taught economics major with broader general education, including language and social-science courses. The published curriculum incorporates undergraduate research, industrial practice and a graduation thesis, with electives in areas such as trade, monetary economics and game theory. An overseas study semester is encouraged, while internships and advanced theoretical courses support different employment or further-study plans.

programmes.name: Global Bachelor of Fintech (GBF)
programmes.language: English (courses offered by International School of Finance)
programmes.about: A finance-and-technology undergraduate programme integrating business, economics, data analytics and applied financial technology.
programmes.overview: The four-year programme brings together financial theory, business foundations, statistics, computing and technologies used in financial services. Its indicative curriculum includes mathematics, accounting, microeconomics, macroeconomics, corporate finance, econometrics, Python and computer science. Students can choose electives in financial practices or quantitative technology, and the school describes case-based learning, industry projects and internship support. A practicum and thesis connect academic study with possible pathways in finance, consulting, analytical roles or graduate education.

programmes.name: Undergraduate International Program in Data Science and Big Data Technology (UIPDB)
programmes.credential: Bachelor's degree (Data Science and Big Data Technology)
programmes.language: English (courses offered by School of Data Science)
programmes.about: A four-year data-science programme combining statistics, mathematical foundations, computing and applied artificial intelligence.
programmes.overview: Students study calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, programming and data structures as foundations for data-intensive problem-solving. Core courses extend into optimisation, machine learning, deep learning, algorithms and other artificial-intelligence topics. Elective modules cover statistical analysis, systems and data mining, or applications of data science in the social sciences. The provisional study plan includes professional internship experience and a thesis, and describes preparation for analytical work in technology, finance or public bodies and related postgraduate study.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
programmes.campus: Shanghai (specific campus and hospital placements not stated)
programmes.language: English-taught (includes Chinese-language and Medical Chinese courses)
programmes.about: A six-year, English-taught first medical degree covering biomedical sciences, clinical disciplines and clinical-practice preparation.
programmes.overview: The programme begins with biomedical and foundational subjects, including anatomy, physiology, biochemistry, pathology and pharmacology, before extending into clinical medicine, diagnostics, surgery, paediatrics and other specialties. Clinical skills and practical experience form an explicit part of the academic approach, with overseas clinical internships described as an opportunity for selected students. The curriculum also includes Chinese language and Medical Chinese despite the English-taught designation. Graduates may seek medical licensing examinations, subject to the independent rules of the country where they wish to practise.
